statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (canvas '68r', the left of three panels; overview and one enlarged view of the panel). A field of 29 labelled stars between a sun face at the top and a moon face at the bottom, with faint blue rays in the middle; 11 of the stars have a small dot or ring at the centre and 18 do not. The count of 29 stars equals the number of single label lines (f68r1.8 to 36). Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read. The order is my assumption: stars taken in horizontal bands from top to bottom and left to right within a band, the n-th star given the n-th label line; because the stars are scattered rather than in rows, this order may differ from the transcription's for several stars, so each star's position is recorded as a fraction of the panel to allow re-matching. The circular line f68r1.37 is given to the moon it surrounds.
